Subtract 277 days from 1150-01-01.  
1150 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
277 days back: go to previous year 1149.  
From 1150-01-01 back 1 day → 1149-12-31.  
Back another 276 days: 1149-12-31 minus 276 days.  
Days in 1149: 365.  
1149-12-31 is day 365. Day 365 − 276 = day 89 of 1149.  
1149 is not a leap year (1149 ÷ 4 = 287.25).  
Jan 31 days, Feb 28 days → 31+28=59, so day 89 is March 30 (89 − 59 = 30).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1149-03-30
